item.tib: stag la me 'bar gyi dbang chog bye'u g.yung drung 'phar ma byad kha zlog pa'i dbang khrid
item.coloph: ston pa stag la me 'bar la/ lha nor bcu gsum phul nas/ phung bon mgo dmar bdag gis zhus/ rgya gsum gyis rgyas gdab/ 'di la shog ser bsdebs pa gnyis 'dug pa zhal bshus so/ dpon gsas khyung rgod rtsal gyis zhal bzang brag nas thon pa u ya// yaH
